title: 航线规划功能失效
description: 火炬驱动航线规划出错且到达后无法重新规划，同时规划航线功能整体失效，两者均表现为航线规划系统无法正常工作。
evidence: constant issues with torch drive course plotting correctly or worse after spending days in game to get somewhere it bugs out kicks you out and you cannot replot a course from there

evidence_items.quote: constant issues with torch drive course plotting correctly or worse after spending days in game to get somewhere it bugs out kicks you out and you cannot replot a course from there

evidence_items.quote_zh: 火炬驱动器的航线规划持续出现问题，或者更糟的是，在游戏中花了几天时间到达某处后，它出bug把你踢出去，你无法从那里重新规划航线
